question: What triggers a vehicle mobility hit and how long does it last?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/vehicle-mobility-hit.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Trigger (0x214 to 0x414): for each new damage event with damage above 0, sum = damage + stored sum; if sum >= scale x `MobilityHitDamageThreshold`, apply `Affector_Vehicles_MobilityDamage` for `MobilityHitDuration` and set the sum to 0; otherwise store the sum.
Window (0x55c to 0x678): the sum is set to 0 when ticks since the recorded hit exceed `MobilityHitTimeFrame` / max(frame time, 1/240).
Removal (0x438 to 0x4ec): `Affector_Vehicles_RemoveMobilityDamge` is applied when `Vehicle Health Normalized` equals 1 and a stored flag is set.
Defaults (already recorded): threshold 0.5, duration 5 s, time frame 3 s.
Effect of a mobility hit by class (L4031, L4033): tanks lose speed and turning, boats lose thrust, helicopters have two flight parameters halved, jets get random roll and nose-down pitch.
Vehicle health and critical-health thresholds are not in expression graphs; they remain as recorded in L3347 and L3348.

inference: The scale multiplying the threshold comes from an unnamed native call; with 0.5 it is most likely maximum health (half of maximum health within 3 s).
unresolved: The scale is not identified; an in-game test (damage a tank by just under and just over half its health within 3 s) would settle it.
The stored flag that gates removal is unnamed.
The graph body is the 1.4.3.0 capture; it was not re-captured for 1.4.3.5.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Vehicle mobility hit rule read: damage is summed per vehicle and a mobility hit is applied for MobilityHitDuration when the sum reaches a scale x MobilityHitDamageThreshold within MobilityHitTimeFrame; it is removed at full health
leads.summary: `SimEx_Vehicle_MobilityDamage` was read in full. Each damage event adds to a stored sum; when the sum reaches a scale x `MobilityHitDamageThreshold` (0.5) the mobility damage effect is applied for `MobilityHitDuration` (5 s) and the sum resets. The sum also resets once `MobilityHitTimeFrame` (3 s) has passed since the recorded hit. The effect is removed when normalised health equals 1. The scale is probably maximum health. 2 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: The scale is identified, or an in-game mobility hit contradicts the half-health reading.
leads.statusNote: Mobility hit rule read; scale inferred.
